summary: Added a --stdin flag to 'auth set-token' so the API key can be piped in instead of passed as a positional argument.
reason: Greptile's publish review (mvanhorn/printing-press-library PR #1794) found that the generated 'auth set-token <token>' command required the credential as args[0], exposing it via the process argument list (ps) and shell history. The positional form is kept for backward compatibility but --stdin is now documented as the preferred path. Likely a systemic gap in the generated auth.go template across CLIs with api_key auth; flagging via retro as well.
validated_outcome: go build succeeded; manually verified 'echo token | jules-pp-cli auth set-token --stdin' and the original positional form both save the credential correctly.
